summary: MU's S1 pin is CONFIRMED. Episode 12 (2021-06-27, the S1 finale) adapts mainline chapters 43-46 in running order — the whole back half of tankobon volume 6 — and closes on ch 46's final beat (the concert announcement, Nagatoro dragging Senpai to the auditorium), so the END is 46 with no mid-chapter straddle. START is 43 (the episode opens on ch 43's material: Senpai showing the paintings, the girls scouting the President's work, the counter-plan; the manga plays that as a flashback, the anime plays it chronologically). The post-credits scene is the EPILOGUE OF CHAPTER 8 — first-time pages (episode 4 adapted ch 8 but replaced the real cheek kiss with the doll gag), a back-reach that is annotated `rearranged` and does not move the END (A4, 'pages, not numbers'). Independent confirmation of the terminal: Kodansha's own volume-6 TOC lists eight chapters ending with the title the episode's second segment carries verbatim (愛とか言われちゃってますよぉセンパーイ？ = ch 46), ja-WP's 各話リスト prints that title pair for 第12話, and the licensor's story page #12 synopsis matches the ch 43-46 span. MU's string is 'Vol 1, Chap 1 (S1) / Vol 7, Chap 47 (S2)' → 'Vol 6, Chap 46 (S1) / Vol 12, Chap 91 (S2)': this entry is S1 only, the S1 segment is the one that binds (G32/G37 — the S2 value belongs to 2nd Attack, a separate entry), and the S1 pin is REDUNDANT with the honest terminal (G56). Chapter space: the mainline ceiling is 154, not 189 (see structure).

continue_points.note: C5: coverage +1. Season 1 ends on the last page of ch 46, which is also the last chapter of volume 6 — resume at ch 47 「センパイと私の仲なんスから〜」, the opening chapter of volume 7. Two chapters inside the covered range were never animated in this season and can be read at leisure: ch 31 「冒険心ってものがセンパイに足りないとこなんですよ」 and ch 33 「センパイ、弁当なんですか？」 (both vol 5, self-contained gag chapters) — no S1 episode page names either (C3 skip note). Most Bonus / Side Story extras are likewise unadapted or adapted out of order. (Continuation note, not a mapping claim: the 2023 second season 2nd Attack — a separate catalog entry — begins at exactly ch 47; its first episode carries that chapter's title verbatim.)

annotations.note: Two reorderings. (1) The post-credits scene animates the EPILOGUE of ch 8 — Nagatoro's real kiss on the cheek — for the first time: ep 4 adapted ch 8 but swapped that ending for an anime-original doll gag, so these are first-time pages reached out of order 38 chapters behind the END (they do not move it, A4). (2) Ch 43 opens in the manga with the panel-decorating walk and tells the art-room scene as Senpai's flashback; the episode plays the same material chronologically.

Ch 46's Public Morals Committee confrontation is a short corridor scene in the manga in which Senpai and the girls do not intervene; the anime relocates it to the disciplinary room and adds a defence of the President's painting (Yoshi's speech is anime-original). Anime-original padding only — the episode's plot is the source's throughout, so the row stays canon under T28.

CHAPTER SPACE (N35 candidate). The mainline ceiling is 154, agreed by three independent sources: MangaUpdates' record (latest_chapter 154; status string '20 Volumes (Complete) / 154 Chapters + 26 Bonus + 6 Side Story (Complete)'), MangaDex's series metadata for Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san (lastChapter 154, lastVolume 20), and nagatoro.fandom's Category:Chapters, which holds exactly 154 pages titled 'Chapter N' (max 154) plus 51 non-mainline pages (Bonus 0-29, Side Story 1-10, Anime Extra 1-4, Issue 1-5, one crossover, one index page). Our stored total_chapters=189 is therefore a UNIT count, not a mainline chapter number: 154 mainline + extras (MU's own extras count, 26+6=32, gives 186; the fandom counts more extras than MU does, so no source reproduces 189 exactly). latest_known=154 is the correct mainline ceiling and is the space every anchor here lives in. Recommend treating 189 as a unit count (display/ceiling logic should use 154).
